summary: Iteration 4 (bug fix: demo login routing by role) verified end-to-end. BACKEND (3/3 new tests pass + no regression): POST /api/auth/login for cliente@zappyfood.com returns user.role='cliente' AND user.active_role='cliente'; lojista@zappyfood.com returns role='lojista' AND active_role='lojista'; entregador@zappyfood.com returns role='entregador' AND active_role='entregador'. Confirmed the idempotent repair in seed_data() (server.py L1490-1499) runs on every backend startup, forcing correct roles regardless of prior switch-role mutations. FRONTEND (390x844, all 3 flows PASS): Sign-in shows the two-mode selector (Cliente/Lojista vs Entregador). Test 1 - clicking sign-in-demo-cliente prefills cliente@zappyfood.com/cliente123 and 'Entrar' routes to CLIENTE tabs (Início/Buscar/Pedidos/Perfil) with 'Olá, Demo' greeting - no Lojista panel shown. Test 2 - sign-in-demo-lojista prefills lojista credentials and 'Entrar' routes to LOJISTA panel showing 'Burger House', 'Receita hoje R$ 94,64', 'Fila de pedidos', Cupons/Promoções, Entregadores, tabs Painel/Pedidos/Produtos/Loja - no cliente 'Restaurantes' list. Test 3 - login-mode-entregador + sign-in-demo-entregador prefills entregador@zappyfood.com/12345678900 and 'Entrar' opens Área do entregador with tabs Entregas/Meu saldo and courier orders list. No red screens. Bug 'demo cliente abria acesso do lojista e vice-versa' is fully resolved.

issues: Pre-existing warnings (not iter4 regressions): 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents).

action_items: Optional hardening (not required for this bug): consider also enforcing 'active_role == role' on the /auth/switch-role endpoint for the two demo emails, or excluding cliente@ and lojista@ from switch-role mutations, so that mid-session switch-role calls cannot re-corrupt the demo accounts until the next backend restart. Currently the repair only runs at startup.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_data() correctly applies the two update_one($set role/active_role) calls BEFORE the early-return that skips seeding when stores already exist — so the repair runs even on already-seeded DBs. Good.
Gate in frontend/app/_layout.tsx routes by active_role which is exactly what the backend now guarantees for demo users on startup.

sign-in.tsx fillDemo() writes the correct email/password pairs for each demo kind; testIDs (sign-in-demo-cliente/lojista/entregador, sign-in-submit, sign-in-email/password, login-mode-geral/entregador) are all present and functional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 demo login flows: cliente->cliente area, lojista->lojista panel, entregador->entregador area)

seed_data_creation: None. Restarted backend once to trigger the idempotent seed_data() repair before running tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix confirmed. Do NOT press 'Modo Lojista'/'Modo Cliente' switch buttons while validating this fix — the /auth/switch-role endpoint permanently mutates active_role and would re-corrupt the demo accounts until the next backend restart. To re-run cleanly: sudo supervisorctl restart backend to force seed_data() repair, then execute pytest /app/backend/tests/test_demo_role_fix.py.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: /api/auth/switch-role persists active_role changes on the user document (server.py L399-404). Because prior test runs pressed the in-app 'Modo Lojista'/'Modo Cliente' buttons on the demo accounts, cliente@zappyfood.com had active_role='lojista' (and vice-versa) stored in Mongo. On next login the Gate (frontend _layout.tsx) routed by that leaked active_role, so the cliente demo opened the lojista area and vice-versa. FIX: seed_data() (server.py L1490-1499) now performs two idempotent update_one($set role, active_role) calls placed BEFORE the 'skip if stores exist' short-circuit, so every backend startup restores the two demo users to their canonical roles. VERIFIED: after supervisor restart, /api/auth/login for both accounts returns the correct role/active_role pair and the frontend Gate routes each demo to its correct area.
